goal_a_reason: Free-text paraphrasing requires semantic similarity judgment (no tool-call inspection needed), which is exactly what llm-judge-output provides.
goal_b_reason: Structured JSON with known expected values, tolerating key ordering and minor whitespace differences, is the deterministic tree-based comparison json-similarity was designed for.
